patthana18.3:1.1: Hetuṃ hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nahetu ceva naahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:2.1: Nahetuṃ sahetukañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naahetuko ceva nanahetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:3.1: Hetuṃ hetuñceva hetusampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:4.1: Nahetuṃ hetusampayuttañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu nahetuvippayutto ceva nanahetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:5.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nahetu nasahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā adhipatiyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:6.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nahetu naahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
